consequence.statement: OCIRepository v1beta2 objects that omit status.artifact.digest are rejected by the schema.

original.statement: In the OCIRepository v1beta2 CRD schema, status.artifact.digest is now required, and objects that omit it are rejected.

decision.reason: Comparing the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install manifests [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2], the deterministic validators (semvalidate.crd crd-schema:required, restatement:crd:field-required) confirmed that status.artifact.digest is newly required in the OCIRepository v1beta2 schema. The computed diff says objects that omit the field are rejected, which fits resource-rejected. The evidence does not say who writes status.artifact, and I have not assumed it is the controller, so it cannot narrow who is exposed. That is why my confidence is low.
